title: 029 · Chilled food outside the merchant's temperature range
initial_explanation: We are the coordinator, Iona Quill. The client is Enna Vosk. From the case card: the refrigerated grocery delivery DL-029 has an out-of-range logger reading under the merchant's own order conditions, and food-safety staff must decide the disposition.

coordinator.name: Iona Quill
coordinator.responsibility: Run the case: pass the recorded temperature evidence to the merchant's authorised food-safety staff and get their disposition and remedy, without making a safety judgment.

recipient.name: Enna Vosk
recipient.responsibility: Report the logger reading and whether anything was eaten, and ask for the merchant's instructions and remedy.

safety_intake.name: Food-safety intake
safety_intake.responsibility: Report the order's temperature condition and the logger reading, and say who may authorise disposition.

safety_lead.name: Food-safety lead
safety_lead.responsibility: Decide the disposition of the contents and the remedy for this order.

goal: Get the merchant's authorised food-safety team to confirm its disposition and remedy for this order, without the desk making any safety judgment.
limits: Treat the temperature range as the merchant's own order condition, not a universal legal rule.

intake.summary: Get the merchant's disposition and remedy for chilled delivery DL-029 after an out-of-range logger reading.
intake.note: Creation time is taken from the case card. The history has no separate system event for ticket creation.

initial.blocker: The logger reading is out of range; no disposition has been decided.

Logger excerpt: sensor BL-29, handover capture 2026-03-02 08:50 UTC, 9.2 °C.
The merchant states that the 9.2 °C reading is outside its range.
Only the merchant's food-safety staff may authorise disposition.

steps.explanation: Enna has eaten nothing from the box and asks what to do and whether the merchant will replace it. We cannot answer either question ourselves, so we escalate the reading to the merchant's food-safety staff without advising consumption.

steps.explanation: The food-safety lead said not to consume the contents, pointed to the portal disposal instructions and authorised a no-charge replacement. This is the authorised team's decision, so the coordination task can be closed; the replacement delivery is not booked yet.
